lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the Layer B reviewer finding on test/vendor/check-agent-frontmatter-standalone.test.ts's file-size ceiling: US-R1-001 grew the file to 84 lines (adding the CAM-286 'no model: key' regression case) but left its scripts/file-size-budget.json ceiling at the stale 58, so `bun run check:all` failed at the file-size step, which broke US-001/US-002/US-003's own 'Lint spine passes (bun run check:all)' acceptance criterion. Raised the ceiling to 84 (confirmed via the actual `content.split('\n').length` count the gate reports, NOT `wc -l`, which under-reports by one for this trailing-newline file -- first attempt at 83 from `wc -l` still failed the gate by exactly one line) and prepended a dated _ref tracker note (cam/issue-286, US-R2-001, CAM-286) staged in the same commit as the ceiling bump, per the existing ratchet convention. No source/vendor logic changed; this is a pure gate-config fix. All quality gates green: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 4342 pass / 0 fail, full `bun run check:all` spine (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) clean.
